design_philosophy: Apple meets premium SaaS — ultra-clean, expansive breathing room, glassmorphism cards with subtle borders. A godly conversion-driven aesthetic focusing on white themes and glassmorphic overlays.

rules: No Inter for headings (per E1 rules). Use Plus Jakarta Sans exclusively for a unified, premium SaaS identity.
Headlines > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing.
Generous Spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults.
Never center-align paragraphs; left-align dense text for readability.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment for buttons with icons.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, toggles, and forms MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='pricing-toggle-yearly', data-testid='contact-form-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute strictly within the LIGHT theme constraint. Do not use dark mode inversion.
Implement the Three.js orb in the Hero using @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei. Keep it white/violet themed.
Do not use placeholder image services like via.placeholder.com. Use the Unsplash/Pexels URLs provided in this document.
For the custom cursor, map it to window mousemove and use framer-motion or GSAP for the trailing effect.
For the magnetic buttons, calculate mouse position relative to button center on hover.
Strictly follow the typographic scale. Max size for H1 is text-6xl fluid.
Ensure glassmorphism has a subtle white border (border-white/40) to define edges against the white/gray background.
Do not overdo gradients; rely on pure white and soft gray (#F7F7F8) with the violet (#6C5CE7) acting as the main pop of color.
